lines: 第二十三章：崴脚了
回去的路上，林昆半路就下车了，他让出租车送章小雅回海辰别墅区，自己则在路边又拦了辆车直奔幼儿园，到幼儿园的时候，时间刚四点二十多一点，他就站在幼儿园大门旁的梧桐树下抽烟乘凉打发时间。
远处，一辆红色的卡罗拉靠边停下，林昆一眼就认出那是楚静瑶的车。
楚静瑶穿着一身玫粉色的职业装，脚上踩着一双十厘米镶钻的水晶鞋，鼻梁上架着一个精致的太阳镜，腋下夹着某奢侈大牌最新款的包包。
推开车门的一瞬间，无数的目光向她看了过来，她就像是一块巨大发光的宝石，人群中总是那么璀璨耀眼，总能吸引来自四面八方的眼神。
‘嗒’的一声轻响，水晶鞋十厘米的锥根落地，所有人的心脏骤然一紧，仿佛这一声‘嗒’是踏在他们的心坎上发出的。
楚静瑶从车上下来，窈窕的身影玉立在下午四点钟的阳光下愈发动人，气质出众的像是寒冬腊月里盛开的玉兰，脚下交错的步伐仿佛盛开的莲花蔓延，就连无意间抬手托起镜架的一个小动作，都是那么迷人……
“咕噜”已经有人开始咽口水了，也有人看的醉了，一副呆呆的神情。
“老婆，这儿！”
突然的一声叫喊，顿时打破了整幅画面的美感，就好像一拳砸在了玻璃上，整个画面碎的霹雳啪啦的，所有人都被这一声叫喊回过了神，楚静瑶更是差点摔了个跟头，脚下一个不平稳，脚踝处‘嘎嘣’一声，崴脚了。
楚静瑶‘啊’的痛叫一声，额头上顿时渗出一层细汗，眼神幽怨杀气腾腾的看向林昆，林昆表情一愣，嘴角的笑容僵硬到石化，真没想到他随便喊的一句，竟酿出了如此严重的后果，赶紧就跑过去扶楚静瑶。
不等林昆跑到跟前，楚静瑶身旁的一辆丰田霸道里跳下来一个瘦猴男，就想要扶楚静瑶，林昆一看这还了得，直接脚底下一发力冲了过去。
这瘦猴男的如意算盘打的不错，想来个近水楼台先得月，趁机跟女神搭个讪揩个油啥的，结果他刚张开臂弯做出一个扶的手势，就觉得身子轻飘飘的飞了起来，是真的飞了起来，他看到自己的双脚脱离了地面……
林昆以子弹头的速度冲过来，并且毫不客气的扬起了他那44码的大脚板子，冲着瘦猴男的屁股就踢了过来，直接把这厮像皮球一样给踢飞了。
在众人目光的注视下，瘦猴男在空中划过一道蹩脚的抛物线，呼通一声坠地，那场面叫个疼啊，四肢张开的趴在地上，像个大癞蛤蟆一样。
这边，林昆拍拍手，得意的道：“老子老婆的便宜，岂是随便就能占的！”
周围的人顿时一阵汗颜，刚才那些有心想要‘英雄救美’的男人们，这会儿都悄悄的把那小心思给藏了起来，生怕自己一不小心也被踢飞了。
林昆回过头，嘴角勾起一丝潇洒的弧度冲楚静瑶微笑，结果换来的却是楚静瑶冷冰冰的表情，和那冷如刀子一般凛冽的眼神，他赶紧收回笑脸，张开双臂扶住楚静瑶，关切的问道：“老婆，你的脚没事吧……”
瘦猴男被摔的不轻，浑身的骨头都要裂了，他晃荡着脑袋爬了起来，冲着周围的人群就嚷嚷骂道：“麻痹的，刚才是谁踢的老子，站出来！”
没人回答他，都是一副好笑的表情看着他，他感觉鼻子黏糊糊的，摸了一把竟然出血了，这时也不知道哪个气死人不偿命的夹在人群里嗲声嗲气的喊了句：“哎妈呀哥们，你鼻子来事了……”
“哈哈哈哈哈……”周围顿时暴起一阵大笑。
瘦猴男怒不可遏，回过头，正好看到了扶着楚静瑶的林昆，心里顿时了然，气势汹汹的就冲着林昆走了过去，“麻痹的，刚才是你踢的我吧！”

Chapter 23: Sprained ankle
On the way back, Lin Kun got off the car halfway. He asked a taxi to take Zhang Xiaoya back to the Haichen Villa area, and he stopped a car on the roadside and went straight to the kindergarten. When he arrived at the kindergarten, it was just after 4:20, and he stood under the sycamore tree next to the kindergarten gate to smoke and enjoy the coolness to pass the time.
In the distance, a red Corolla pulled over and Lin Kun recognized it as Chu Jingyao's car at a glance.
Chu Jingyao was wearing a rose-pink professional attire, a pair of ten-centimeter diamond-encrusted crystal shoes on her feet, a pair of exquisite sunglasses on her nose, and the latest bag from a luxury brand under her arm.
The moment she opened the car door, countless eyes looked at her. She was like a huge luminous gem, always so bright and dazzling in the crowd, always attracting eyes from all directions.
There was a soft 'tap' sound, and the ten-centimeter cone of the glass shoe fell to the ground. Everyone's heart suddenly tightened, as if this 'tap' was coming from stepping on their hearts.
Chu Jingyao got out of the car, her slender figure became more and more attractive in the sunshine at four o'clock in the afternoon. Her temperament was as outstanding as the magnolia blooming in the cold winter. The staggered steps under her feet were like the spread of a blooming lotus. Even the small movement of unintentionally raising her hand to hold up the frame of the glasses was so charming...
"Gulu" some people have started to swallow their saliva, and some people are drunk and have a blank look on their faces.
"Honey, here!"
A sudden shout immediately broke the beauty of the whole picture. It was like a punch hitting the glass. The whole picture shattered with thunder. Everyone was brought back to their senses by the cry. Chu Jingyao almost fell down. Her feet were unstable, and there was a 'bang' at her ankle, which caused her ankle to sprain.
Chu Jingyao screamed in pain, and a layer of sweat suddenly appeared on her forehead. She looked at Lin Kun with a murderous look in her eyes. Lin Kun's expression was stunned, and the smile at the corner of his mouth was so stiff that it turned to stone. He really didn't expect that his casual shout would have such serious consequences, so he hurried over to help Chu Jingyao.
Before Lin Kun could run up to him, a thin monkey man jumped out of a Toyota Overlord next to Chu Jingyao and wanted to help Chu Jingyao. When Lin Kun saw that it was okay, he rushed over with all his strength.
This skinny monkey man made a good plan. He wanted to get the moon first on a tower near the water, so he took the opportunity to chat with the goddess for a while. As a result, as soon as he opened his arms and made a supporting gesture, he felt that his body was flying lightly. It was really flying. He saw his feet leaving the ground...
"Get out!"
Lin Kun rushed over at the speed of a bullet, and unceremoniously raised his 44-yard big feet and kicked the skinny monkey man on the butt, sending the guy flying away like a ball.
Under the gaze of everyone, the thin monkey man drew a crappy parabola in the air and fell to the ground with a roar. The scene was so painful that he lay on the ground with his limbs spread out, like a big toad.
Here, Lin Kun clapped his hands and said proudly: "How can I take advantage of my wife casually?"
The people around him suddenly felt ashamed. The men who had wanted to be a hero and save the beauty just now secretly hid their thoughts, for fear that they would be kicked away accidentally.
Lin Kun turned around and smiled at Chu Jingyao with a chic curve at the corner of his mouth. What he got in exchange was Chu Jingyao's cold expression and her eyes as cold as knives. He quickly withdrew his smile, opened his arms to support Chu Jingyao, and asked with concern: "Honey, are your feet okay..."
The thin monkey man was thrown so hard that all the bones in his body were about to break. He got up with his head shaking, and yelled at the crowd around him: "Paralyzed, who kicked me just now, stand up!"
No one answered him, they all looked at him with funny expressions. He felt his nose was sticky, and it actually started to bleed when he touched it. At this time, someone who was so angry that he didn't want to pay for his life got caught in the crowd and shouted: "Oh my god, brother, something is wrong with your nose..."
"Hahahahaha..." A burst of laughter suddenly broke out around them.
The thin monkey man was furious. He turned around and saw Lin Kun supporting Chu Jingyao. He suddenly understood and walked towards Lin Kun angrily, "Paralyzed, you were the one who kicked me just now!"
